title: Residence, Thalawathugoda
summary: A calm, warm family home: a gallery-like entrance foyer, a double-height living room and an intimate dining room in soft greys, dark timber and brass.
description:
The entrance foyer is arranged as a small gallery. A long timber sideboard with brass-toned, pyramid-faceted doors sits beneath a large lily-pond painting, picked out by ceiling-mounted adjustable spotlights. Marble-look floor tiles and soft grey walls keep the space light, while the timber entrance doors open onto the garden.

The living room rises to a pitched ceiling with exposed dark timber rafters. A deep, grey modular sofa wraps the corner beneath a ring chandelier of crystal-like pendants, with slim glass wall lights and full-height curtains softening the tall walls.

In the dining room, a six-seat timber table with softly rounded corners is paired with upholstered chairs in a pale textured fabric. Three smoked-glass globe pendants hang at staggered heights over the table, a round white-framed mirror reflects the garden light, and full-height wave curtains with sheers frame the windows.
